description: This file defines the Operations class which implements logical functions such as AND, OR, XOR, and NOT for use within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation engine. It provides methods to evaluate logical expressions, handling various input types including arrays, references, and scalar values.

classes.name: Operations
classes.description: Provides static methods implementing logical functions such as AND, OR, XOR, and NOT for spreadsheet calculations.

methods.name: logicalAnd
methods.description: Evaluates whether all arguments are TRUE, returning TRUE, FALSE, or error.

methods.name: logicalOr
methods.description: Evaluates whether any argument is TRUE, returning TRUE, FALSE, or error.

methods.name: logicalXor
methods.description: Evaluates whether the number of TRUE arguments is odd, returning TRUE, FALSE, or error.

methods.name: NOT
methods.description: Returns the inverse of a logical value or expression.
